message.content: This editorial illustration features the title "TEMPO" in large gold letters above the text "SAATNYABLAKBLAKAN". A subtitle reads: "Cerita di belakang panggung tentang liputan yang jadi perhatian publik. Dari rekening gendut hingga mafia pemalsu lukisan." A large man in a tan uniform with pink arms pulls a yellow rope looped around a green pig and a brown pig. Between his legs, a smaller man in a green uniform rides a motorized vehicle with a pink tank. In the foreground, a large yellow-skinned woman in a white garment holds a green plate with a slice of pink meat topped with a black "DK" flag. In the upper right, a figure in blue digs into a green hill with a shovel. The landscape includes yellow and green hills, small white houses with red roofs, and stylized trees. Below, a blue water area contains a partially submerged gray pillar. Text at the top includes "EDISI KHUSUS 45 TAHUN" and "7-13 MARET 2016". The bottom left displays a barcode and "RP 39.500".
